minor_findings: End-to-end Signal ingress used synthetic/injected messages only; real-device envelope and delivery semantics remain unvalidated.
2FA flow used test doubles only; real provider timing, rate limits and code-format variance remain unobserved.
Service supervision was verified by active state/restart counters, but full reboot ordering remains unobserved.
Safety-number verification is an out-of-band trust ceremony; until performed, peer identity rests on TOFU, acceptable only as documented isolated-plane risk.
required_operator_actions: Send one real inbound Signal message and confirm the single-account receive path.
Complete one real 2FA code round trip and record it.
Perform out-of-band Signal safety-number verification and log the fingerprint.
Schedule a full comms-01 reboot and verify all six services, zero restarts and 0660 sockets.
rationale: All engineering-reachable items are evidenced: ten-file hash parity, 42 tests, strict artifact containment, negative command rejection, Hermes isolation, socket ownership, rollback extraction, and no broker/ledger/production DB/network/prior-run mutation. The four remaining items intrinsically require live counterparts or an operational window and are not engineering blockers.
